H1000.def: from the same as «0948»; an egg (from its whiteness):--egg.

H1002.def: of foreign origin; a castle or palace:--palace.

H1004.def: probably from «01129» abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.):--court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, × great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter)house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, + prison, + steward, + tablet, temple, web, + within(-out).

H1006.def: the same as «01004»; Bajith, a place in Palestine:--Bajith.

H1007.def: from «01004» and «0205»; house of vanity; Beth- Aven, a place in Palestine:--Beth-aven.

H1008.def: from «01004» and «0410»; house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine:--Beth-el.

H1009.def: from «01004» and «0695» and «0410»; house of God's ambush; Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine:--Beth-Arbel.

H1010.def: from «01004» and «01168» and «04583»; house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) Beyth M own {bayth me-own'}; house of habitation of (Baal); Beth- Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine:--Beth-baal-meon. Compare «01186» and «01194».

H1011.def: from «01004» and «01254»; house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine:--Beth-birei.

H1012.def: probably from «01004» and «05679»; house of (the) ford; Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine:--Beth-barah.

H1013.def: from «01004» and «01447»; house of (the) wall; Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine:--Beth-gader.

H1014.et: from (01004) and the pass. participle of (01576)
H1014.def: from «01004» and the passive participle of «01576»; house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan:--Beth- gamul.

H1015.def: from «01004» and the dual of «01690»; house of (the) two figcakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan:--Beth-diblathaim.

H1016.def: from «01004» and «01712»; house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine:--Beth-dagon.

H1017.et: patrial from (01008) with the article interposed
H1017.def: patrial from «01008» with the article interposed; a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel:--Bethelite.

H1018.et: from (01004) and (0681) with the article interposed
H1018.def: from «01004» and «0681» with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine:--Beth- ezel.

H1019.et: from (01004) and (01537) with the article interposed
H1019.def: from «01004» and «01537» with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine:--Beth-gilgal.

H1020.et: from (01004) and the plural of (03451) with the article interposed
H1020.def: from «01004» and the plural of «03451» with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha- Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan:--Beth-jeshimoth.

H1021.et: from (01004) and (03754) with the article interposed
H1021.def: from «01004» and «03754» with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine:--Beth-haccerem.

H1022.et: patrial from (01035) with the article inserted
H1022.def: patrial from «01035» with the article inserted; a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem:--Bethlehemite.

H1023.et: from (01004) and (04801) with the article interposed
H1023.def: from «01004» and «04801» with the article interposed; house of the breadth; Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine:--place that was far off.

H1024.et: from (01004) and the pl. of (4818) (with or without the article interposed)
H1024.def: or (shortened) Beyth Mar-kabowth {bayth mar-kaw-both'}; from «01004» and the plural of «04818» (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots; Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine:--Beth-marcaboth.

H1025.et: from (01004) and (06010) with the article interposed
H1025.def: from «01004» and «06010» with the article interposed; house of the valley; Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine:--Beth- emek.

H1026.et: from (01004) and (06160) with the article interposed
H1026.def: from «01004» and «06160» with the article interposed; house of the Desert; Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine:--Beth-arabah.

H1027.et: from (01004) and (07311) with the article interposed
H1027.def: from «01004» and «07311» with the article interposed; house of the height; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan:--Beth-aram.

H1028.def: probably for «01027»; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan:--Beth-haran.

H1029.et: from (01004) and (07848) with the article interposed
H1029.def: from «01004» and «07848» with the article interposed; house of the acacia; Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine:--Beth-shittah.

H1030.et: patrial from (01053) with the article inserted
H1030.def: patrial from «01053» with the article inserted; a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh:--Bethshemite.

H1031.def: from «01004» and the same as «02295»; house of a partridge; Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine:--Beth-hoglah.

H1032.def: from «01004» and «02356»; house of hollowness; Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine:--Beth- horon.

H1033.def: from «01004» and «03733»; house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine:--Beth-car.

H1034.et: from (01004) and the pl. of (03833), Compare (03822)
H1034.def: from «01004» and the plural of «03833»; house of lionesses; Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine:--Beth-lebaoth. Compare «03822».

H1035.def: from «01004» and «03899»; house of bread; Beth- Lechem, a place in Palestine:--Beth-lehem.

H1036.et: from (01004) and the fem. of (06083) (with preposition interposed)
H1036.def: from «01004» and the feminine of «06083» (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust; Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine:--house of Aphrah.

H1037.def: or Beyth Mil-loh {bayth mil-lo'}; from «01004» and «04407»; house of (the) rampart; Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels:-- house of Millo.

H1038.def: from «01004» and «04601»; house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine:--Beth-maachah.

H1039.et: from (01004) and the fem. of (05246), Compare (05247)
H1039.def: from «01004» and the feminine of «05246»; house of (the) leopard; Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan:--Beth-Nimrah. Compare «05247».

H1040.def: from «01004» and «05730»; house of pleasure; Beth-Eden, a place in Syria:--Beth-eden.

H1041.def: from «01004» and «05820»; house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine:--Beth-az-maveth. Compare «05820».

H1042.def: from «01004» and a plural from «06030»; house of replies; Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine:--Beth-anoth.

H1043.def: an orthographical variation for «01042»; Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine:--Beth-anath.

H1044.def: from «01004» and a derivative of «06123»; house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing); Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine:-- shearing house.

H1045.def: : from «01004» and «06252»; house of Ashtoreths; Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine:--house of Ashtaroth. Compare «01203», «06252».

H1046.def: from «01004» and «06412»; house of escape; Beth- Palet, a place in Palestine:--Beth-palet.

H1047.def: from «01004» and «06465»; house of Peor; Beth- Peor, a place East of the Jordan:--Beth-peor.

H1048.def: from «01004» and a derivative from «06327»; house of dispersion; Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine:--Beth-pazzez.

H1049.def: from «01004» and «06697»; house of (the) rock; Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine:--Beth-zur.

H1050.def: from «01004» and «07339»; house of (the) street; Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine:--Beth-rehob.

H1051.def: from «01004» and «07497»; house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite:--Beth-rapha.

H1052.def: or Beyth Shan {bayth shawn'}; from «01004» and «07599»; house of ease; Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine:--Beth- shean, Beth-Shan.

H1053.def: from «01004» and «08121»; house of (the) sun; Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine:--Beth-shemesh.

H1054.def: from «01004» and «08598»; house of (the) apple; Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine:--Beth-tappuah.

H1055.def: probably from «01004»; a palace (i.e. large house):--palace.

H1056.def: from «01058», weeping; Baca, a valley in Palestine:--Baca.

H1057.def: the same as «01056»; the weeping tree (some gum- distilling tree, perhaps the balsam):--mulberry tree.

H1058.def: a primitive root; to weep; generally to bemoan:--X at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, × more, mourn, × sore, × with tears, weep.

H1061.def: from «01069»; the first-fruits of the crop:--first fruit (-ripe (figuratively)), hasty fruit.

H1062.def: or (short) bkorah {bek-o-raw'}; feminine of «01060»; the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture:--birthright, firstborn(-ling).

H1064.def: feminine of «01062»; primogeniture; Bekorath, an Israelite:--Bechorath.

H1065.def: from «01058»; a weeping; by analogy, a dripping:--overflowing, × sore, (continual) weeping, wept.

H1066.def: plural active participle of «01058»; (with the article) the weepers; Bo-kim, a place in Palestine:--Bochim.

H1069.def: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from «01061») to give the birthright:--make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

H1070.def: from «01069» (in the sense of youth); a young camel:-- dromedary.

H1071.def: the same as «01070»; Beker, the name of two Israelites:-- Becher.

H1073.def: by orthographical variation for «01063»; a first- ripe fig:--firstripe.

H1076.def: patronymically from «01071»; a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker:--Bachrites.

H1077.def: from «01086»; properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest:--lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

H1078.def: by contraction for «01168»; Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians:-- Bel.

H1079.def: (Aramaic) from «01080»; properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat):--heart.

H1080.et: corresponding to (01086) (used only in a mental sense)
H1080.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01086» (but used only in a mental sense); to afflict:--wear out.

H1081.def: from «01078» and «0113» (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince:--Baladan.

H1082.def: a primitive root; to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction):--comfort, (recover) strength(-en).

H1083.def: from «01082»; desistance; Bilgah, the name of two Israelites:--Bilgah.

H1085.def: of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends:--Bildad.

H1086.def: a primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend):--consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

H1088.def: feminine of «01087»; failure; Balah, a place in Palestine:--Balah.

H1089.et: a primitive root [rather by transposition for (0926)]
H1089.def: a primitive root (rather by transposition for «0926»); to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify:--trouble.

H1090.def: from «01089»; timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine:--Bilhah.

H1092.def: from «01089»; timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite:--Bilhan.

H1093.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «01086»; excise (on articles consumed):--tribute.

H1094.def: or (fully) blowy {bel-o'ee}; from «01086»; (only in plural construction) rags:--old.

H1095.def: of foreign derivation; Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel:--Belteshazzar.

H1097.def: from «01086»; properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.:--corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

H1098.def: from «01101»; mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle):--corn, fodder, provender.
